Who we are

About Med Spok Solutions

Med Spok Solutions Pvt Ltd supplies, installs and maintains medical equipment for hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and patients at home, from our premises in Porur, Chennai.

What we do

Supply, installation and service under one roof

We supply CPAP and BiPAP machines and masks, oxygen concentrators and cylinders, suction machines, patient monitors, wheelchairs, hospital cots and physiotherapy supports.

Everything here is available on rent or on sale. Rental suits short-term needs such as post-operative recovery. Purchase suits long-term therapy. We advise on which fits the case, including when that means a smaller order for us.

We stock devices and masks from Home Medix, BMC, ResMed and SVASTEK as an authorized dealer, covering consultation, site assessment, installation, training, preventive maintenance, calibration and spare parts. Sourcing and biomedical engineering are handled in-house.

Our mission

Dependable equipment, wherever the patient is

To make dependable medical equipment available across hospitals and homes, supported by a service team that responds quickly.

Our vision

The supplier people rely on

To be the supplier that hospitals, physicians and families rely on, known for accurate advice, clear pricing and dependable service.
